proof.criterion: After main's #2392 removed the commit-order lock, the suggestion outcome sweep never moves its cursor past an event that is still committing: it reads only up to the safe horizon, judges the held event once after it commits, and costs at most one pass per minimum gap while the horizon is held
proof.surface: go test on a real Postgres 16 (pgserver, UTF8) with the real events.Broker and events.Horizon, at the fix head
proof.command: cd packages/envoy && go test -p 2 -parallel 4 -count=1 ./internal/dispatch/api/ -run 'TestTheSuggestionSweepTrailsTheSafeHorizon|TestTheFirstPassOfAJustStartedProcessStartsAtTheNewestEvent|Suggestion|Maintenance|Sweep'; then one at a time -timeout 30m: ./internal/dispatch/api/ ./internal/dispatch/store/ ./internal/pgmigrate/ ./internal/dispatch/events/ ./cmd/dispatch/ ./internal/dispatch/docs/
proof.observed: the held-insert test passes: cursor below the held id and suggestion pending after the first pass, with a later pass requested; judged once and cursor at or past it after the commit. First-pass test: a just-started Horizon's pass starts a null cursor at the newest event. Suites ok: store 222 s (fresh database), pgmigrate, events, cmd/dispatch 252 s, docs 986 s; api ok but for main's C-locale collation guard. Build and vet (both tags, infra, natslive) clean; connections 90. PR comment 6534600973.
proof.negativeControl: the same held-insert test on the merge without the fix failed: 'cursor = 6 after a pass run while event 5 could still commit; want it below that id'; the first-pass test without the Await step failed: 'cursor = 0 after the first pass of a just-started process; want 3'

trickyParts: A fresh events.Horizon answers 0 until a later observation proves an earlier one, so the first pass after boot takes Await; otherwise a null cursor would start at 0 and the sweep would page the whole log
Any transaction holding a transaction id on the instance holds the horizon back; the sweep then runs one pass per minimum gap, never a tight loop
